scale.usable_n_evidence: adni-go2-plasma-lipidomics / Real numbers section: 'we retained a total of 4730 samples from 1519 participants… 1393 participants had plasma lipidome profiling since baseline' [PMC12269576]
scale.usable_n_for_request_reason: The 1517 headline N contains all diagnostic groups across all timepoints. For biomarker validation (the requested use case), the actionable discriminator set is stable AD (n=243) vs stable CN (n=337) = 580 subjects at baseline. MCI-to-AD conversion sub-group = 329 converters; if the buyer's validation target is conversion prediction, 329 is the operative N. Both figures substantially exceed the 200-participant minimum.
scale.multi_site_potential: ADNI runs at 60+ US sites with centralised protocol and reference labs; same Baker Institute platform used for ASPREE (Australia, n=3495 with NIST SRM 1950 cross-cohort harmonisation documented in PMC12269576) — combining ADNI + ASPREE plasma lipidomics yields ~5225 total samples with 402 confirmed dementia cases, feasible on same analytic pipeline.
scale.axis_summary: 580 usable subjects for AD-vs-CN discrimination (329 for conversion prediction); 10-year longitudinal span with effective density at 0–24 months; multi-site aggregation with ASPREE is the strongest expansion path.

confounders.medication_omega3: documented: 398 lipid species associated with omega-3 use (Supplementary Table S7) [PMC12269576]
confounders.medication_anticholinesterase: documented and acted on: deDE lipid class excluded from modelling due to anticholinesterase confounding [PMC12269576]
confounders.demographics: age, sex, APOE genotype all captured; predominantly non-Hispanic White, mean age >74; APOE ε4 enriched by design
confounders.verdict: good — the buyer's explicit hard negative (statin confounding) is fully addressed with formal quantification; 423 statin-sensitive species documented, adjustment methodology available

platform_validation.cross_platform_replication: 68.25% of mappable lipids replicated in independent ADNI serum MXP500 dataset (internal cross-platform) [PMC12706616 cited in adni-go2-serum-metabolomics-mxp500]
platform_validation.verdict: good — same-platform external validation in ASPREE is documented; cross-platform replication in ADNI serum MXP500 is documented

scale.usable_n_evidence: adni-go2-serum-metabolomics-mxp500 / Overview: '1,430 participants; 4,063 samples. Diagnostic breakdown: CN n=383, stable MCI n=423, MCI converters (CN→MCI) n=66, AD converters (CN/MCI→AD) n=294, AD n=264' [PMC12706616]
scale.usable_n_for_request_reason: For biomarker validation: AD converters (n=294) + stable AD (n=264) = 558 AD-group subjects; CN (n=383) controls. AD vs CN discriminator set = 264 + 383 = 647. For conversion prediction: AD converter arm n=294 — the primary actionable group per the entity. MCI-converter arm (n=66) is underpowered for subgroup analyses.
scale.multi_site_potential: Same ADNI multi-site infrastructure (60+ US sites); Biocrates MXP500 platform used at Duke ADMC — also used at NIEHS NIA platform and multiple academic cores, enabling potential aggregation with other Biocrates MXP500 datasets. Internal cross-platform replication with adni-go2-plasma-lipidomics (68.25% overlap) is documented.
scale.axis_summary: 647 usable subjects for AD-vs-CN discrimination (294 for conversion prediction); 7-year longitudinal span; Biocrates MXP500 multi-site aggregation possible; serum matrix is the operative constraint.

scale.usable_n_evidence: aspree-dementia-casecohort-lipidomics / Real numbers: 'the case-cohort subset (n = 3495) contained incident dementia (n = 402) with an average follow-up of 6.5 years' [PMC12269576]
scale.usable_n_for_request_reason: For biomarker validation, the operative N is the 402 incident dementia cases (the endpoint events). The 3093 non-demented controls are available for discrimination modelling. However, incident dementia endpoint is broader than confirmed AD — buyer should estimate ~60–70% AD fraction in elderly Australian population trial = ~240–280 confirmed AD events, still above the 200-participant minimum.
scale.multi_site_potential: ASPREE was multi-site across Australia (community-based trial); Baker Institute platform is identical to ADNI plasma lipidomics — cross-cohort harmonisation via NIST SRM 1950 already documented and applied in PMC12269576. ADNI + ASPREE joint analysis is the strongest multi-site plasma lipidomics option in the wiki.
scale.axis_summary: 402 incident dementia cases (est. 240–280 confirmed AD) with 6.5-year prospective follow-up; population-based setting (unlike clinic-recruited ADNI) — high generalisability value; cross-cohort harmonisation with ADNI documented.
